title.zh: Prime Agent召集2200个Agent重写自己，启动快13倍
title.en: Prime Agent召集2200个Agent重写自己，启动快13倍

current_state.zh: Prime Intellect released a Rust rewrite of its open-source Prime Agent coding tool, produced by a two-week orchestration of 2,200+ agents in 10,000+ sandboxes that cut cold-start time from ~738ms to ~56ms (13x) and memory from ~607MB to ~106MB.
